proposals.whyCommon: The flagship accounting internship every Big 4 firm runs in Singapore; the standard entry point for undergraduates into external audit.
requiredSkills: vouching and tracing transactions to source documents
audit software / data analytics exposure (e.g. CaseWare)

candidateEdges.rationale: An assurance intern is a trainee external auditor: the day-to-day of testing balances, vouching to source documents, and building workpapers is exactly the junior half of this role.
Controls walkthroughs and transaction testing overlap; both an undergrad and advisor would see assurance work as a plausible bridge into internal audit even though scoping differs.
Reading and reconciling a full set of statements against reporting standards is the same knowledge base the accountant uses to prepare them, so audit exposure reads as relevant preparation.

proposals.whyCommon: Dedicated tax internships are a standing Big 4 and mid-tier service line in Singapore, distinct from the combined accounting-and-tax role and recruited every intake.
requiredSkills: tax law and IRAS guidance research
reviewing income statements and expense records
attention to detail on arithmetic and data entry

candidateEdges.rationale: A tax intern does the junior work of the consultant role directly: preparing computations, researching tax treatment, and drafting returns under review.
Tax work requires reading income statements and expense documentation to determine treatment, which an advisor would accept as adjacent to statement preparation.

proposals.whyCommon: Risk Advisory (internal audit, controls, and regulatory compliance) is a standing Big 4 service line that recruits interns each intake in Singapore.

candidateEdges.rationale: Risk advisory internal-audit interns do the core internal-audit work of walkthroughs, controls testing, and recommendation drafting; this is the recognised feeder role.
Evaluating activity against regulatory standards and writing examination-style findings is central to both, and undergrads routinely enter compliance through risk advisory.
Controls testing and evidence documentation overlap with financial-statement audit, a link both a student and advisor would accept even though the opinion scope differs.

proposals.whyCommon: Big 4 Forensic and Financial Advisory practices run investigation and dispute-support internships in Singapore, though intakes are seasonally thinner than audit or tax.
requiredSkills: transaction tracing and reconstruction from records

candidateEdges.rationale: A forensic-advisory intern does the junior version of this role directly: reconstructing trails from messy records and running analytics to surface anomalies.
Financial-crime and AML investigation work overlaps regulatory-violation review, a bridge both a student and advisor would recognise.
Fraud detection, evidence documentation, and tracing to source are shared with audit testing, a plausible but weaker adjacency.
